question: Okay please look into All relationships that have been revoked And then look at the application user access and check to see if there are any missing pieces there

queries.purpose: Count revoked relationships across access tables and application access statuses.
queries.sql: SELECT 'idp_group_memberships' AS source, COUNT(*) AS revoked_count FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'idp_app_assignments', COUNT(*) FROM idp_app_assignments WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'workspace_group_memberships', COUNT(*) FROM workspace_group_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'drive_permissions', COUNT(*) FROM drive_permissions WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'workspace_oauth_grants', COUNT(*) FROM workspace_oauth_grants WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'github_org_memberships', COUNT(*) FROM github_org_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'github_team_memberships', COUNT(*) FROM github_team_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'github_team_repo_permissions', COUNT(*) FROM github_team_repo_permissions WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'github_repo_collaborators', COUNT(*) FROM github_repo_collaborators WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'application_user_access', COUNT(*) FROM application_user_access WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'revoked';

queries.purpose: Summarize application access rows by status and revocation timestamp consistency.
queries.sql: SELECT status, CASE WHEN revoked_at IS NULL THEN 'no_revoked_at' ELSE 'has_revoked_at' END AS timestamp_state, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM application_user_access GROUP BY status, timestamp_state ORDER BY status, timestamp_state;

queries.purpose: List audit event types related to revocation or deprovisioning.
queries.sql: SELECT system, event_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM audit_events WHERE event_type LIKE '%revok%' OR event_type LIKE '%deprovision%' OR event_type LIKE '%membership.remov%' OR event_type LIKE '%unassign%' GROUP BY system, event_type ORDER BY event_count DESC;

queries.purpose: Count application access mismatches against current direct and nested IdP assignments.
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE account_groups(account_id, group_id, depth) AS ( SELECT member_id, group_id, 1 FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE member_type = 'account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION SELECT ag.account_id, m.group_id, ag.depth + 1 FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_group_memberships m ON m.member_type = 'group' AND m.member_id = ag.group_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ag.depth < 10 ), expected AS ( SELECT principal_id AS account_id, application_id FROM idp_app_assignments WHERE principal_type = 'account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION SELECT ag.account_id, x.application_id FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_app_assignments x ON x.principal_type = 'group' AND x.principal_id = ag.group_id AND x.revoked_at IS NULL ), pairs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT account_id, application_id FROM expected ), issues AS ( SELECT 'expected_missing_row' AS issue, p.account_id, p.application_id, NULL AS access_id FROM pairs p LEFT JOIN application_user_access u ON u.idp_account_id = p.account_id AND u.application_id = p.application_id WHERE u.access_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'expected_not_active', p.account_id, p.application_id, u.access_id FROM pairs p JOIN application_user_access u ON u.idp_account_id = p.account_id AND u.application_id = p.application_id WHERE u.status <> 'active' UNION ALL SELECT 'active_scim_without_assignment', u.idp_account_id, u.application_id, u.access_id FROM application_user_access u LEFT JOIN pairs p ON p.account_id = u.idp_account_id AND p.application_id = u.application_id WHERE u.status = 'active' AND u.provisioning_source = 'idp_scim' AND p.account_id IS NULL ) SELECT issue, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM issues GROUP BY issue ORDER BY issue_count DESC;

queries.purpose: Summarize revoked relationship timing and affected distinct principals.
queries.sql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS revoked_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS distinct_subjects, MIN(revoked_at) AS earliest_revoked_at, MAX(revoked_at) AS latest_revoked_at FROM ( SELECT 'idp_group_memberships' AS source, member_id AS subject_id, revoked_at FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'workspace_group_memberships', member_id, revoked_at FROM workspace_group_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'github_org_memberships', account_id, revoked_at FROM github_org_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'github_team_memberships', account_id, revoked_at FROM github_team_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'application_user_access', idp_account_id, revoked_at FROM application_user_access WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY source ORDER BY source;

queries.purpose: Check whether revoked application access rows belong to ended workers or disabled IdP accounts.
queries.sql: SELECT p.employment_status, ia.status AS idp_status, COUNT(*) AS revoked_access_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT u.idp_account_id) AS accounts FROM application_user_access u JOIN idp_accounts ia ON ia.account_id = u.idp_account_id LEFT JOIN people p ON p.person_id = ia.person_id WHERE u.status = 'revoked' GROUP BY p.employment_status, ia.status ORDER BY revoked_access_rows DESC;

queries.purpose: Check application access row completeness and timestamp ordering.
queries.sql: SELECT issue, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'revoked' AND revoked_at IS NULL THEN 'revoked_missing_timestamp' WHEN status <> 'revoked' AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'nonrevoked_has_timestamp' WHEN revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at < assigned_at THEN 'revoked_before_assigned' WHEN last_authenticated_at IS NOT NULL AND last_authenticated_at > '2026-08-15T12:00:00Z' THEN 'future_authentication' WHEN last_mfa_at IS NOT NULL AND last_authenticated_at IS NOT NULL AND last_mfa_at > last_authenticated_at THEN 'mfa_after_last_auth' END AS issue FROM application_user_access ) WHERE issue IS NOT NULL GROUP BY issue;

queries.purpose: Find revoked-relationship accounts that still have non-revoked application access.
queries.sql: WITH revoked_accounts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT member_id AS account_id FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE member_type = 'account' AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL ) SELECT u.access_id, u.idp_account_id, a.application_id, a.name AS application_name, u.status, u.provisioning_source, u.assigned_at, u.revoked_at, ia.status AS idp_status, p.person_id, p.employment_status FROM revoked_accounts r JOIN application_user_access u ON u.idp_account_id = r.account_id JOIN applications a ON a.application_id = u.application_id JOIN idp_accounts ia ON ia.account_id = u.idp_account_id LEFT JOIN people p ON p.person_id = ia.person_id WHERE u.status <> 'revoked' OR u.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY u.idp_account_id, a.name;

queries.purpose: List current assignments whose application access is not active.
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE account_groups(account_id, group_id, membership_id, depth) AS ( SELECT member_id, group_id, membership_id, 1 FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE member_type = 'account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION SELECT ag.account_id, m.group_id, m.membership_id, ag.depth + 1 FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_group_memberships m ON m.member_type = 'group' AND m.member_id = ag.group_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ag.depth < 10 ), expected AS ( SELECT assignment_id, principal_id AS account_id, application_id, principal_type, principal_id FROM idp_app_assignments WHERE principal_type = 'account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT x.assignment_id, ag.account_id, x.application_id, x.principal_type, x.principal_id FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_app_assignments x ON x.principal_type = 'group' AND x.principal_id = ag.group_id AND x.revoked_at IS NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT e.assignment_id, e.account_id, e.application_id, a.name AS application_name, e.principal_type, e.principal_id, u.access_id, u.status, u.revoked_at, ia.status AS idp_status, p.person_id, p.employment_status FROM expected e JOIN application_user_access u ON u.idp_account_id=e.account_id AND u.application_id=e.application_id JOIN applications a ON a.application_id=e.application_id JOIN idp_accounts ia ON ia.account_id=e.account_id LEFT JOIN people p ON p.person_id=ia.person_id WHERE u.status <> 'active' ORDER BY e.account_id, e.application_id;

queries.purpose: Break down expected assignments missing application access by account and employment state.
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE account_groups(account_id, group_id, depth) AS ( SELECT member_id, group_id, 1 FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE member_type='account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION SELECT ag.account_id, m.group_id, ag.depth+1 FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='group' AND m.member_id=ag.group_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ag.depth<10 ), expected AS ( SELECT principal_id account_id, application_id FROM idp_app_assignments WHERE principal_type='account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION SELECT ag.account_id, x.application_id FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_app_assignments x ON x.principal_type='group' AND x.principal_id=ag.group_id AND x.revoked_at IS NULL ), pairs AS (SELECT DISTINCT account_id, application_id FROM expected) SELECT ia.status AS idp_status, p.employment_status, COUNT(*) AS missing_pairs, COUNT(DISTINCT q.account_id) AS accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT q.application_id) AS applications FROM pairs q JOIN idp_accounts ia ON ia.account_id=q.account_id LEFT JOIN people p ON p.person_id=ia.person_id LEFT JOIN application_user_access u ON u.idp_account_id=q.account_id AND u.application_id=q.application_id WHERE u.access_id IS NULL GROUP BY ia.status, p.employment_status ORDER BY missing_pairs DESC;

queries.purpose: List application access rows with revocation before assignment.
queries.sql: SELECT u.access_id, u.idp_account_id, u.application_id, a.name AS application_name, u.assigned_at, u.revoked_at, ia.status AS idp_status, p.person_id, p.employment_status FROM application_user_access u JOIN applications a ON a.application_id=u.application_id JOIN idp_accounts ia ON ia.account_id=u.idp_account_id LEFT JOIN people p ON p.person_id=ia.person_id WHERE u.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND u.revoked_at < u.assigned_at ORDER BY u.revoked_at;

queries.purpose: List expected application access missing for ended workers.
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE account_groups(account_id, group_id, membership_id, depth) AS ( SELECT member_id, group_id, membership_id, 1 FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE member_type='account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION SELECT ag.account_id, m.group_id, m.membership_id, ag.depth+1 FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='group' AND m.member_id=ag.group_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ag.depth<10 ), expected AS ( SELECT assignment_id, principal_id account_id, application_id, principal_type, principal_id, NULL AS membership_id FROM idp_app_assignments WHERE principal_type='account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT x.assignment_id, ag.account_id, x.application_id, x.principal_type, x.principal_id, ag.membership_id FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_app_assignments x ON x.principal_type='group' AND x.principal_id=ag.group_id AND x.revoked_at IS NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT e.assignment_id, e.membership_id, e.account_id, e.application_id, a.name AS application_name, p.person_id, p.full_name, p.employment_status, ia.status AS idp_status FROM expected e JOIN idp_accounts ia ON ia.account_id=e.account_id JOIN people p ON p.person_id=ia.person_id JOIN applications a ON a.application_id=e.application_id LEFT JOIN application_user_access u ON u.idp_account_id=e.account_id AND u.application_id=e.application_id WHERE u.access_id IS NULL AND p.employment_status='ended' ORDER BY e.account_id;

queries.purpose: Return representative missing access rows for active workers with assignment evidence.
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE account_groups(account_id, group_id, membership_id, depth) AS ( SELECT member_id, group_id, membership_id, 1 FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE member_type='account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION SELECT ag.account_id, m.group_id, m.membership_id, ag.depth+1 FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='group' AND m.member_id=ag.group_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ag.depth<10 ), expected AS ( SELECT assignment_id, principal_id account_id, application_id, principal_type, principal_id, NULL AS membership_id FROM idp_app_assignments WHERE principal_type='account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT x.assignment_id, ag.account_id, x.application_id, x.principal_type, x.principal_id, ag.membership_id FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_app_assignments x ON x.principal_type='group' AND x.principal_id=ag.group_id AND x.revoked_at IS NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT e.assignment_id, e.membership_id, e.account_id, e.application_id, a.name AS application_name, p.person_id, p.employment_status, ia.status AS idp_status FROM expected e JOIN idp_accounts ia ON ia.account_id=e.account_id JOIN people p ON p.person_id=ia.person_id JOIN applications a ON a.application_id=e.application_id LEFT JOIN application_user_access u ON u.idp_account_id=e.account_id AND u.application_id=e.application_id WHERE u.access_id IS NULL AND p.employment_status='active' ORDER BY e.account_id, e.application_id LIMIT 10;

queries.purpose: Return representative active SCIM access rows lacking any current IdP assignment.
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE account_groups(account_id, group_id, depth) AS ( SELECT member_id, group_id, 1 FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE member_type='account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION SELECT ag.account_id, m.group_id, ag.depth+1 FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='group' AND m.member_id=ag.group_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ag.depth<10 ), expected AS ( SELECT principal_id account_id, application_id FROM idp_app_assignments WHERE principal_type='account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION SELECT ag.account_id, x.application_id FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_app_assignments x ON x.principal_type='group' AND x.principal_id=ag.group_id AND x.revoked_at IS NULL ), pairs AS (SELECT DISTINCT account_id, application_id FROM expected) SELECT u.access_id, u.idp_account_id, u.application_id, a.name AS application_name, u.status, u.provisioning_source, p.person_id, p.employment_status, ia.status AS idp_status FROM application_user_access u JOIN applications a ON a.application_id=u.application_id JOIN idp_accounts ia ON ia.account_id=u.idp_account_id LEFT JOIN people p ON p.person_id=ia.person_id LEFT JOIN pairs q ON q.account_id=u.idp_account_id AND q.application_id=u.application_id WHERE u.status='active' AND u.provisioning_source='idp_scim' AND q.account_id IS NULL ORDER BY u.idp_account_id, u.application_id LIMIT 10;

queries.purpose: Check coverage of revoked IdP account memberships by revoked application access.
queries.sql: WITH revoked_accounts AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id account_id FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE member_type='account' AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL), app_summary AS (SELECT idp_account_id account_id, COUNT(*) total_rows, SUM(status='revoked' AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL) revoked_rows, SUM(status<>'revoked' OR revoked_at IS NULL) open_rows FROM application_user_access GROUP BY idp_account_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS revoked_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN s.account_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS without_app_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN s.open_rows=0 AND s.revoked_rows=s.total_rows THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_app_rows_revoked, SUM(CASE WHEN s.open_rows>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_open_app_rows FROM revoked_accounts r LEFT JOIN app_summary s ON s.account_id=r.account_id;

queries.purpose: Return representative revoked relationship IDs from each affected relationship table.
queries.sql: WITH rows AS ( SELECT 'idp_group_memberships' source, membership_id record_id, revoked_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 'idp_group_memberships' ORDER BY revoked_at DESC, membership_id) rn FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'workspace_group_memberships', membership_id, revoked_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 'workspace_group_memberships' ORDER BY revoked_at DESC, membership_id) FROM workspace_group_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'github_org_memberships', membership_id, revoked_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 'github_org_memberships' ORDER BY revoked_at DESC, membership_id) FROM github_org_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'github_team_memberships', membership_id, revoked_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 'github_team_memberships' ORDER BY revoked_at DESC, membership_id) FROM github_team_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'application_user_access', access_id, revoked_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 'application_user_access' ORDER BY revoked_at DESC, access_id) FROM application_user_access WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL ) SELECT source, record_id, revoked_at FROM rows WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY source, revoked_at DESC;

queries.purpose: Trace current group memberships behind the ended worker with revoked access but a current GitHub assignment.
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE account_groups(group_id, membership_id, via_group_id, depth) AS ( SELECT group_id, membership_id, NULL, 1 FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE member_type='account' AND member_id='idpa_001395' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION SELECT m.group_id, m.membership_id, ag.group_id, ag.depth+1 FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='group' AND m.member_id=ag.group_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ag.depth<10 ) SELECT ag.membership_id, ag.group_id, g.name group_name, ag.via_group_id, ag.depth, x.assignment_id, x.application_id, a.name application_name, u.access_id, u.status access_status, p.person_id, p.employment_status, ia.status idp_status FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_groups g ON g.group_id=ag.group_id LEFT JOIN idp_app_assignments x ON x.principal_type='group' AND x.principal_id=ag.group_id AND x.revoked_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN applications a ON a.application_id=x.application_id LEFT JOIN application_user_access u ON u.idp_account_id='idpa_001395' AND u.application_id=x.application_id JOIN idp_accounts ia ON ia.account_id='idpa_001395' JOIN people p ON p.person_id=ia.person_id WHERE x.assignment_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ag.depth;

queries.purpose: Summarize assignment-access reconciliation gaps by application.
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE account_groups(account_id, group_id, depth) AS ( SELECT member_id, group_id, 1 FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE member_type='account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION SELECT ag.account_id, m.group_id, ag.depth+1 FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='group' AND m.member_id=ag.group_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ag.depth<10 ), expected AS ( SELECT principal_id account_id, application_id FROM idp_app_assignments WHERE principal_type='account' AND revoked_at IS NULL UNION SELECT ag.account_id, x.application_id FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_app_assignments x ON x.principal_type='group' AND x.principal_id=ag.group_id AND x.revoked_at IS NULL ), pairs AS (SELECT DISTINCT account_id, application_id FROM expected), issues AS ( SELECT 'expected_missing_row' issue, q.application_id FROM pairs q LEFT JOIN application_user_access u ON u.idp_account_id=q.account_id AND u.application_id=q.application_id WHERE u.access_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'active_scim_without_assignment', u.application_id FROM application_user_access u LEFT JOIN pairs q ON q.account_id=u.idp_account_id AND q.application_id=u.application_id WHERE u.status='active' AND u.provisioning_source='idp_scim' AND q.account_id IS NULL ) SELECT i.issue, a.application_id, a.name, COUNT(*) issue_count FROM issues i JOIN applications a ON a.application_id=i.application_id GROUP BY i.issue,a.application_id,a.name ORDER BY i.issue,issue_count DESC;

report.summary: Revocation coverage is complete for the 66 affected IdP accounts, but application access reconciliation has major gaps: 1,894 expected rows are missing and 5,647 active SCIM rows lack current assignments.

findings.title: Revoked accounts fully closed
findings.statement: All 66 accounts with revoked direct IdP group relationships have application rows, and every such row is revoked; none remains open.

findings.title: Revocations span five datasets
findings.statement: Revocations appear in IdP and Workspace groups, GitHub organization and teams, and application access; other relationship tables have none.

findings.title: Expected access rows missing
findings.statement: Current assignments produce 1,894 account-application pairs with no application access row, including 1,862 for active workers and two for ended workers.

findings.title: SCIM assignment linkage absent
findings.statement: There are 5,647 active SCIM access rows without a current direct or nested IdP assignment, indicating assignment-record gaps or provisioning drift.

findings.title: Three assignment-state conflicts
findings.statement: Two prehires have suspended assigned access, while one ended worker retains a nested GitHub assignment despite revoked access and a deprovisioned IdP account.

findings.title: Revocation chronology is invalid
findings.statement: Twenty-two revoked application rows have revocation timestamps earlier than assignment timestamps, so their lifecycle history is internally inconsistent.

data_gaps: No matching revocation or deprovisioning audit event types were found, and audit history is incomplete, so the cause of reconciliation gaps cannot be confirmed.
recommended_actions: Validate the 1,894 expected-but-missing application rows, prioritizing the two ended workers with active IdP accounts.
Reconcile the 5,647 active SCIM rows against the IdP assignment export and document applications provisioned outside these assignment records.
Remove or justify the ended worker’s lingering nested GitHub group assignment.
Correct the 22 application lifecycle records whose revocation predates assignment.
Review the two suspended prehire access rows before their start dates.

proposed_tools.name: list_revoked_relationships
proposed_tools.description: Lists revoked relationships across supported systems through a supplied snapshot time, returning the record IDs needed for evidence.

parameters.name: snapshot_at
parameters.description: Snapshot timestamp through which revocations should be included.

proposed_tools.sql: SELECT 'idp_group_membership' AS relationship_type, membership_id AS record_id, member_type AS subject_type, member_id AS subject_id, group_id AS object_id, revoked_at FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at <= :snapshot_at UNION ALL SELECT 'workspace_group_membership', membership_id, member_type, member_id, group_id, revoked_at FROM workspace_group_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at <= :snapshot_at UNION ALL SELECT 'github_org_membership', membership_id, 'account', account_id, 'organization', revoked_at FROM github_org_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at <= :snapshot_at UNION ALL SELECT 'github_team_membership', membership_id, 'account', account_id, team_id, revoked_at FROM github_team_memberships WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at <= :snapshot_at UNION ALL SELECT 'application_user_access', access_id, 'idp_account', idp_account_id, application_id, revoked_at FROM application_user_access WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at <= :snapshot_at ORDER BY revoked_at DESC

proposed_tools.name: reconcile_idp_assignments_to_app_access
proposed_tools.description: Compares current direct and nested IdP assignments with application-reported access and returns missing or non-active access rows with evidence IDs.

parameters.name: snapshot_at
parameters.description: Timestamp used to determine which memberships and assignments are current.

proposed_tools.sql: WITH RECURSIVE account_groups(account_id, group_id, membership_id, depth) AS ( SELECT member_id, group_id, membership_id, 1 FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE member_type='account' AND granted_at <= :snapshot_at AND (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at > :snapshot_at) UNION SELECT ag.account_id, m.group_id, m.membership_id, ag.depth+1 FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='group' AND m.member_id=ag.group_id AND m.granted_at <= :snapshot_at AND (m.revoked_at IS NULL OR m.revoked_at > :snapshot_at) WHERE ag.depth<10 ), expected AS ( SELECT assignment_id, principal_id AS account_id, application_id, NULL AS membership_id FROM idp_app_assignments WHERE principal_type='account' AND granted_at <= :snapshot_at AND (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at > :snapshot_at) UNION ALL SELECT x.assignment_id, ag.account_id, x.application_id, ag.membership_id FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_app_assignments x ON x.principal_type='group' AND x.principal_id=ag.group_id AND x.granted_at <= :snapshot_at AND (x.revoked_at IS NULL OR x.revoked_at > :snapshot_at) ), pairs AS ( SELECT account_id, application_id, MIN(assignment_id) AS assignment_id, MIN(membership_id) AS membership_id FROM expected GROUP BY account_id, application_id ) SELECT CASE WHEN u.access_id IS NULL THEN 'missing_access_row' ELSE 'access_not_active' END AS issue, p.assignment_id, p.membership_id, p.account_id, p.application_id, u.access_id, u.status, u.revoked_at FROM pairs p LEFT JOIN application_user_access u ON u.idp_account_id=p.account_id AND u.application_id=p.application_id WHERE u.access_id IS NULL OR u.status<>'active' ORDER BY issue, p.account_id, p.application_id

proposed_tools.name: find_active_scim_without_assignment
proposed_tools.description: Finds active SCIM-provisioned application access without a current direct or nested IdP assignment.

parameters.name: snapshot_at
parameters.description: Timestamp used to determine current memberships and assignments.

proposed_tools.sql: WITH RECURSIVE account_groups(account_id, group_id, depth) AS ( SELECT member_id, group_id, 1 FROM idp_group_memberships WHERE member_type='account' AND granted_at <= :snapshot_at AND (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at > :snapshot_at) UNION SELECT ag.account_id, m.group_id, ag.depth+1 FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='group' AND m.member_id=ag.group_id AND m.granted_at <= :snapshot_at AND (m.revoked_at IS NULL OR m.revoked_at > :snapshot_at) WHERE ag.depth<10 ), expected AS ( SELECT principal_id AS account_id, application_id FROM idp_app_assignments WHERE principal_type='account' AND granted_at <= :snapshot_at AND (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at > :snapshot_at) UNION SELECT ag.account_id, x.application_id FROM account_groups ag JOIN idp_app_assignments x ON x.principal_type='group' AND x.principal_id=ag.group_id AND x.granted_at <= :snapshot_at AND (x.revoked_at IS NULL OR x.revoked_at > :snapshot_at) ), pairs AS (SELECT DISTINCT account_id, application_id FROM expected) SELECT u.access_id, u.idp_account_id, u.application_id, u.status, u.provisioning_source, ia.person_id FROM application_user_access u JOIN idp_accounts ia ON ia.account_id=u.idp_account_id LEFT JOIN pairs p ON p.account_id=u.idp_account_id AND p.application_id=u.application_id WHERE u.status='active' AND u.provisioning_source='idp_scim' AND p.account_id IS NULL ORDER BY u.idp_account_id, u.application_id

proposed_tools.name: find_invalid_application_access_timestamps
proposed_tools.description: Returns application access rows whose revocation predates assignment or whose activity timestamps are after the snapshot.

parameters.name: snapshot_at
parameters.description: Snapshot timestamp used to detect future activity.

proposed_tools.sql: SELECT access_id, idp_account_id, application_id, assigned_at, revoked_at, last_authenticated_at, last_mfa_at, CASE WHEN revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at < assigned_at THEN 'revoked_before_assigned' WHEN last_authenticated_at IS NOT NULL AND last_authenticated_at > :snapshot_at THEN 'authentication_after_snapshot' WHEN last_mfa_at IS NOT NULL AND last_authenticated_at IS NOT NULL AND last_mfa_at > last_authenticated_at THEN 'mfa_after_last_authentication' END AS issue FROM application_user_access WHERE (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at < assigned_at) OR (last_authenticated_at IS NOT NULL AND last_authenticated_at > :snapshot_at) OR (last_mfa_at IS NOT NULL AND last_authenticated_at IS NOT NULL AND last_mfa_at > last_authenticated_at) ORDER BY access_id
